title: Computer Vision and Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Computer Vision and Machine Learning (CV/ML) Engineer to develop and deploy intelligent perception systems for our autonomous drone-in-a-box platform. You will work on challenging real-world computer vision problems, from real-time object detection and tracking on embedded devices to advanced scene understanding and cloud-based inference. As part of a small, technical team, you will own solutions across our software stack, taking algorithms and models from prototype to deployment. This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a wide variety of computer vision and machine learning features for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications
  • Train, fine-tune and evaluate deep learning models for tasks such as object detection, instance segmentation, image retrieval/reidentification
  • Optimize algorithms and models for edge devices (NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm Dragonwing), and integrate them into our image and video processing pipelines
  • Monitor ML model performance in real-world deployments and set up workflows for continuous improvement (data collection, curation, labeling, retraining, evaluation)
  • Evaluate and integrate large/vision language models for scene understanding, situational awareness, and hazard analysis, including prompt design, performance benchmarking, and production deployment

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Robotics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Solid understanding of computer vision and machine learning fundamentals
  • Strong programming skills in Python and C++, with experience developing production-grade software that powers CV/ML systems
  • Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA
  • Experience with end-to-end model development: from dataset curation, labeling strategies, active learning workflows to deployment and optimization for edge devices
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English
  • Work permit in Switzerland required

Bonus Points

  • Good understanding of 3D vision and robotics perception, along with hands-on experience with OpenCV and ROS/ROS2, is a strong plus
  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm edge devices, and their CV/ML SDKs
  • Experience with transformers, large/vision language models and prompt design for perception tasks
  • Experience with complex GStreamer pipelines and custom plugin development

100% · On-site

title: Experienced Machine Learning Engineer - Spain 🇪🇸 (Spanish speaking)
description:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


The context

Following rapid and profitable growth in France, Doctrine has expanded to Italy and Germany, then acquired Maïté, a Spanish legaltech company, at the start of 2026. 

We are now looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to keep improving our legal AI for the Spanish market. You will work on models and pipelines that process Spanish legal documents, and your work will directly shape the product roadmap for Spain.

Please note: the position is based in Paris, in our offices in the 18th arrondissement.

You can find details about our full stack on GitHub.

Good to know: prior professional experience in the legal field is not required. However, being eager to commit and build expertise in understanding legal documents is essential.


Missions 🛠
  • Develop NLP models (machine learning–based or otherwise) to support information search and recommendation within legal documents, with a particular focus on the Spanish language.
  • Maintain and monitor these models in production.
  • Design conversational agents to help lawyers across different legal domains by ensuring accurate answers and streamlining drafting tasks.
  • Collaborate with various profiles — including engineers, product managers, and product designers to identify new opportunities for product development.
  • Contribute to spreading and consolidating best practices internally, and take part in shaping our Engineering strategy.

    • Ideal Profil 👀
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning (both classical and deep learning) for data extraction and recommendation, ideally with initial experience working with LLMs.
  • Experience with natural language search engines and inverted indexes such as Elasticsearch.
  • A strong interest in artificial intelligence topics.
  • Motivation to identify, analyze, and bring the latest scientific advancements in the field into production.
  • Solid Python development skills, with a focus on algorithm design.
  • Proficiency in both English and Spanish, as you will be working with legal documents in Spanish.

    • Extras of the role 👁
  • Like all engineers at Doctrine, you will join one of our cross-functional chapters — in this case, the Data Science chapter. Within this chapter, you will contribute to internal projects aimed at improving our processes and shaping our long-term vision. The chapter meets every week to:
  • Share knowledge: keep track of the state of the art, review scientific papers, continuous improvement, best practices, etc.
  • Propose improvements: experiment with new tools, suggest new processes to implement.
  • You will also take part in recruitment: all individual contributors meet candidates through technical assessments or interviews.

    • What's in it for you ☀️

    🏡 A flexible remote work policy - up to 3 days of remote work per week

    🌴 A flexible leave policy

    🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

    🏄‍♂️ Regular team events 

    📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

    🍱🚲🏋️‍♀️ Monthly allowance that you can use for sports, wellness activities, subscriptions, and more.

    🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

     

    Our values 🤝

    At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

    Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

    Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

    Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

    Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

     Our hiring process 🚀

    1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.
    2. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions.
    3. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice.
    4. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with the VP of your department.

    (The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.)

    Ladies, go ahead and apply!

    Research shows that women in particular tend not to apply for a role when they don't meet every single requirement. To put your mind at ease: this job description is a guide, nothing more.

    If Doctrine interests you, we'd love to hear from you!

    Diversity & inclusion

    All our roles are open to people with disabilities. Feel free to bring it up at any point during the process. We're committed to putting in place whatever adjustments are needed to ensure a working environment that works for everyone.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance.

As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You also maintain and improve our agents in production, and build the Claude Code skills that automate operational work and save time for the business team. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering.

Understand what drives performance

  • Explore our conversational and behavioural data, alongside campaign performance

  • Track our key metrics, spot what moves, and find out why

  • Surface the hidden patterns that make recommendations more relevant

Ship your findings to production

  • Turn your findings into improvements to our recommendation algorithms and agents, implemented in production

  • Measure the impact directly with A/B tests, and feed the results into the next iteration

  • Industrialise the analyses you run often into automated pipelines and monitoring, reviewed by the engineering team

Improve our agents in production

  • Maintain and improve our agents: prompts, tools, evaluation, and the code around them

  • Turn client feedback into agent improvements: qualify what they ask for, and ship directly what can be handled at the agent level

Automate operations at scale

  • Build and maintain Claude Code skills that automate operational work at scale and free up time for the business team

Profile

Must-have

  • 0 to 3 years of experience, internships and work-study included. Fresh graduates are welcome.

  • Personal projects where you built LLM agents end to end (prompts, tools, evaluation), or ran a serious data analysis on your own

  • Hands-on prompt engineering: you write, test and iterate on prompts, and you measure whether a change actually made things better

  • Solid SQL and Python for analysis

  • The basics of statistics: you know how to read an A/B test and when not to trust a number

  • You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) every day

  • Rigorous and precise: you check your numbers before you share them

  • Fluent French and professional English

A plus

  • A top engineering, business or data school, in France or abroad

  • AI courses or certifications

  • You have founded something, even small, and got real users or paying customers

  • Hackathons, open source, or side projects that went further than a weekend

  • TypeScript

  • Recommender systems, ranking or applied ML experience

  • E-commerce, advertising, growth or conversion experience

  • BigQuery, dbt, PostHog

What we offer

  • Competitive salary plus equity (BSPCE)

  • You learn next to our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, two of them repeat YC founders

  • A dataset very few people will ever see: 100M+ conversations a month between shoppers and AI agents

  • An AI-first team: Claude Code and agents are part of everyone's daily work

  • Ownership that grows fast: you start by taking real work off our plates, and take on more as you prove yourself

title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

Junior Data Scientist

Berlin, On-site

Most Junior Data Scientists spend their first years building dashboards and reporting on what already happened. Here, you'll work on models that run in production and shape what millions of users see every day.

You'll join a small team of people who have built and shipped ML systems at scale, and learn from them directly. You get real problems from week one, and the support to solve them. Show us you can own more, and we'll give you more.

 

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Build models that predict user value, engagement and reward behaviour, and see them live in our product

  • Run A/B tests on offers, rewards and ranking, and work out what actually caused the result

  • Build and fix the data pipelines your models depend on

  • Take on new problems with no playbook yet, from first idea to production

 

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strong Python and SQL. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still check the output

  • You get going on a vague problem without waiting for a spec, and you take it further than you were asked

  • You quickly see which number matters and which question to answer first

  • Proof that you aim high: a project, result or choice where you went past "good enough" when nobody asked you to

  • Bonus: a strong result in a Kaggle challenge, hackathon or competition, or a system you built and fixed yourself when it broke

 

Why Almedia

  • A small, selective team of very sharp people. We keep it small on purpose, so every hire raises the bar

  • Equity in Almedia. Every Berlin-based employee gets a stake, so you share in what you help build

  • Top-of-market pay as the baseline. Outlier impact gets paid accordingly

     

Small team, high bar. If that sounds like home, apply.

 
 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €60K – €85K

title: Chemical Data Scientist
description:
About Valdera:

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.

We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.

Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.

Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

Role Description:

We are hiring a Chemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform.

Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database.

You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources

  • Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale

  • Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics

  • Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers

  • Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings

  • Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources.

  • Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets.

  • Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications

  • Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines

  • Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data

  • Familiarity with building or applying matching, deduplication, or classification models (traditional ML or LLM-based approaches)

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to accelerate data extraction, enrichment, or engineering workflows

  • Startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership — comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment with ambiguous, evolving priorities

Compensation

Additional Information

Salary Range:

Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

title: Experienced Data Engineer (squad Thémis)
description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un.e ingénieur data confirmé pour rejoindre l’une de nos squads et participer à la construction de la première plateforme d’intelligence juridique.
 
Tu rejoindras une équipe dédiée à l’acquisition, l’enrichissement et la mise à disposition de la donnée juridique dans notre plateforme.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Consolider les pipelines de données du périmètre de la squad
  • Concevoir, développer, monitorer et maintenir de nouveaux scripts d’acquisition et de traitement des données en Python pour ajouter de nouveaux contenus dans notre plateforme
  • Assurer la qualité de la donnée et son monitoring
  • Travailler en collaboration avec nos Machine Learning Engineers et experts NLP pour les aider à intégrer leur travail dans le pipeline de données
  • Contribuer à l’évolution de nos outils de pipeline de données (Airflow, Kubernetes, Dask, Amazon S3, PostgreSQL, Terraform, etc...), et faire en sorte d’en tirer le meilleur profit au quotidien
  • Au sein du Chapter Data Engineering, participer à l'élaboration de nos pratiques de modélisation et de traitement des données.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • De bonnes compétences en programmation Python
  • Une expérience des pratiques d'acquisition et de modélisation des données
  • Une bonne connaissance de SQL et du stockage objet
  • Une expérience dans un écosystème cloud (AWS de préférence)
  • L’envie de partager tes connaissances pour participer à la progression de chacun.e
  • La maîtrise de la langue française, car tu seras amené.e à manipuler des données juridiques en français.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.

title: AI Engineer / LLM Engineer
description:
AI Engineer: bouw een AI-agent die echte acties uitvoert, niet alleen tekst

Onze AI-agent praat niet alleen. Hij zoekt bestellingen op in Shopify, maakt retourlabels, doet refunds, maakt kortingscodes aan en beslist wanneer een mens het moet overnemen. Elke dag doet hij dat duizenden keren, voor onze eerste klant: een snelgroeiende e-commerce-organisatie met meerdere webshops.

Squid Support staat vlak voor de publieke lancering. Daarvoor zoeken we een AI Engineer die de agent nog slimmer, veiliger en betrouwbaarder maakt.

Waar je aan werkt

  • Tools en tool calling: welke acties de agent mag doen en hoe hij die kiest

  • Evaluaties en guardrails: meten wanneer de agent het goed of fout doet, en dat verbeteren

  • Prompts en configuratie per merk, A/B-testen van varianten

  • Beeldherkenning: klanten sturen foto's van kapotte producten en verkeerde items

  • Agent-frameworks: OpenAI Agents SDK, LiteLLM, Vertex AI

Hoe we werken

We werken AI-native: Claude Code, Codex en agentic workflows zijn bij ons de standaard. Er zit geen product owner of projectmanager tussen jou en de klant. Je werkt elke dag direct met de oprichters.

Stack: TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Docker. AI via onder andere OpenAI Agents SDK, LiteLLM en Vertex AI.

Wat we zoeken

  • Je bouwt al minstens een jaar dagelijks met Claude Code, Codex, Cursor of vergelijkbaar, en weet wanneer je de output niet moet vertrouwen

  • Je hebt software gebouwd en zelf uitgerold die door echte gebruikers wordt gebruikt

  • Je kunt zelfstandig met een klant om tafel en maakt van een vaag probleem iets wat werkt

  • Minimaal 1,5 jaar professionele ervaring met TypeScript en/of Python

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands

  • Pré: wo-opleiding (ook onafgerond), ervaring met SaaS of een eigen startup

Wat je krijgt

  • Een plek in een klein, ambitieus team, net voor de lancering

  • Elke dag samenwerken met de oprichters, en veel leren

  • Echte ownership: wat jij bouwt, gebruiken klanten de volgende dag

  • Meegroeien met het bedrijf: als wij schalen, groeit jouw rol mee

  • €4.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, MacBook Pro en vrije keuze in AI-tooling

  • Hybride: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Nieuwegein

Stuur bij je sollicitatie een link mee naar iets wat je hebt gebouwd en wat echt gebruikt wordt.

title: AMER Data Analyst - Sales Strategy and Operations
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business.

Responsibilities

  • Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews).
  • Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making.
  • Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management).
  • Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development.
  • Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains.
  • Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems.
  • User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways.
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level.
  • Ability to communicate technical content to non-technical audiences and translate business insights into practical recommendations, with a willingness to grow into presenting to leadership.
  • Experience initiating and completing analytical projects, taking a structured approach to solving unique business problems.
  • Experience in Salesforce (or other CRM). Intermediate to advanced SQL and strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills.
  • Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to creatively solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis in a fast-paced, high-volume business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve analytical and operational workflows.

title: Sales Data Analyst (Part-time)
description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!
 
We are currently looking for a part-time Sales Data Analyst to join our Sales team and transform commercial data into actionable business intelligence. In this role, you will play a key part in sales reporting, performance analysis, forecasting, and opportunity tracking, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. Reporting directly to the Director, B2B Sales & Marketing (Americas) and collaborating closely with Account Managers, Sales Operations, Finance, and other key stakeholders, you will deliver analytical insights that drive revenue growth, improve forecast accuracy, and identify opportunities to optimize sales performance.
 
This role is offered on a part-time basis, with an expected commitment of 20 hours per week.

What you will do
  • Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly sales reports, tracking revenue YTD, actuals versus budget and forecast, and year-over-year performance. 
  • Analyze sales performance by customer, region, brand, product, and SKU to highlight growth, declines, trends, and exceptions. 
  • Produce customer-level performance summaries, including top and underperforming products, sales volumes, and opportunities for follow-up. 
  • Support sales forecasts by consolidating Account Manager inputs, validating assumptions, and identifying gaps or changes versus plan. 
  • Maintain new business and listing opportunity trackers, including expected launch timing, SKU assortment, estimated volumes, annualized value, and dependencies. 
  • Help quantify the current-year and future-year revenue potential of new listings, distribution expansion, and customer initiatives. 
  • Build and update Superset dashboards, NetSuite reports, Excel models, and standardized reporting templates that reduce manual work and improve consistency. 
  • Monitor order, inventory, and fulfillment data where available to flag out-of-stock risks, delayed orders, and potential revenue impact. 
  • Assist in preparing customer business reviews, sales presentations, and management updates with clear data visualizations and commentary. 
  • Reconcile data across NetSuite, Superset, CRM records, and other sales sources; investigate discrepancies and maintain reliable reporting definitions. 
  • Collaborate with Account Managers, Sales Operations, Finance, and other relevant teams to obtain data and clarify performance drivers. 
  • Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to streamline recurring analysis, automate routine reporting tasks, and improve the speed and quality of commercial insights. 
  • Maintain CRM pipeline data quality and work with Account Managers to track opportunities, deal stages, next steps, forecast timing, and key dependencies. 
  • Help evaluate and improve CRM reporting and AI-supported workflows for sales forecasting, opportunity tracking, and account management.

    • What you should bring
  • Proven experience in Sales Analytics, Commercial Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar analytical role;  B2B or consumer goods experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience using NetSuite for sales, order, customer, and revenue reporting, including saved searches or equivalent reporting tools.
  • Experience using Apache Superset to navigate, build, or maintain dashboards and analyze sales performance; basic SQL skills are an asset.
  • Practical experience with CRM systems and sales pipeline management, including opportunity stages, data hygiene, forecasts, and reporting.
  • Comfortable applying AI tools to research, data analysis, reporting, and workflow automation, with sound judgment around accuracy, confidentiality, and validation.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and structured data analysis.
  • Ability to interpret revenue, unit sales, margin, budgets, forecasts, and customer and product performance data.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to reconcile and validate information from multiple business systems.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to turn findings into concise, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable balancing recurring deadlines and ad hoc requests in a part-time schedule. 

    • What we can offer you
  • A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
  • Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
  • Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
  • Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
  • Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
  • Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.

We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

title: Feltsense AI Engineer
description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

  • Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

  • Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

  • Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

  • Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

  • Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

  • Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

  • Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit.

De rol

Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product.

Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning. 

Wat je doet

  • Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten.

  • Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions.

  • Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar.

  • Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling.

  • Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt.

  • Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp.

  • Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels.


Wie je bent

Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een geteste, gemonitorde oplossing op.

Je bent proactief en signaleert zelf wat beter moet. Je bent op je plek in een scale-up: je kunt tegen wat chaos en je brengt structuur aan. Je legt trade-offs helder uit aan niet-technische collega’s.

Je maakt analytics engineers en analisten productief. Kunnen zij een tabel niet vinden, begrijpen of vertrouwen, of lopen ze vast op tooling of toegang, dan is het werk niet af.

Must-haves

  • Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure.

  • Diepgaande ervaring met dbt (Cloud) in productie: Jinja, geautomatiseerd testen, deployment pipelines en environments.

  • Ervaring met het opzetten en structureren van een Git-workflow: branchingstrategie, pull requests en code review.

  • Terraform of andere infrastructure-as-code.

  • Snowflake of een vergelijkbaar warehouse.

  • Python en ingestie via Fivetran of custom connectors.

  • Data tests als standaard, oog voor cloudkosten.

  • Engels op professioneel niveau, schriftelijk en mondeling.

  • Bereid tot een Nederlandse veiligheidsscreening (VGB).

Mooi meegenomen: een warehouse-migratie, Looker of data contracts, gereguleerde of publieke omgevingen, B2B SaaS. 

Stack

Snowflake (huidig warehouse), Databricks (Azure), Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Metabase, Looker.

Wat we bieden

  • Een competitief salaris en de ruimte om data engineering bij Studytube neer te zetten.

  • Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor in de Houthavens, 2 dagen thuis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen plus een vrije dag op je verjaardag.

  • 3% pensioen via a.s.r., volledig betaald door Studytube.

  • € 1.000 leerbudget per jaar, waarvan de helft voor welzijn of je thuiswerkplek.

  • LevelUp Academy, Studygym, MacBook Air en € 10 telefoonvergoeding.

  • Verzorgde lunches tegen een kleine bijdrage, kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijks bedrijfsfeest.

Studytube is het all-in-one leerplatform voor meer dan 600 organisaties, onder wie Bol.com, a.s.r., CZ, Manpower en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s willen we het nummer 1-platform voor professionele ontwikkeling in Europa worden. De datalaag is nu de bottleneck. Wie die recht trekt, maakt de ambities op AI en klantwaarde mogelijk.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Actuator Control & Locomotion), Intern
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather.

This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night.

What You'll Work On

  • Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation.

  • Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots.

  • Make policies robust to varied terrain, challenging weather, and noisy, delayed, or missing sensor data.

  • Explore control approaches that transfer across robot embodiments with different actuators and dynamics.

  • Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: experiment tracking, version control, reproducible training runs.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a motivated robotics or machine learning student excited to apply academic training in a fast-moving startup. You'll be surrounded by a team that values learning, experimentation, and building things that actually work in the real world.

Your Background

  • Currently pursuing a PhD or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related field.

  • Hands-on experience training reinforcement learning policies for robot control, in simulation or on hardware.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or Gazebo.

  • Solid grounding in robot dynamics and control.

  • Good coding skills in Python, with PyTorch (or JAX).

  • Comfortable using Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience deploying learned policies on physical robots, ideally legged.

  • Experience with low-level actuator, motor, or joint control.

  • C++ and ROS 2 experience.

  • Publications at top robotics or ML venues (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS).

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Software Engineer
description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

title: Software Engineer, Dash
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About the Role:

As a Software Engineer at Liftoff working on the Dash team, you will be key in building and scaling the core systems that power our mobile growth platform. You’ll be part of a high-impact engineering team responsible for developing web applications, backing services, APIs and tools that help app developers acquire users, optimize engagement, and drive monetization across millions of devices worldwide.

Your contributions will directly impact the performance, reliability, and scalability of our ad delivery, user acquisition, and analytics products. From designing efficient UIs, APIs and services to supporting machine learning pipelines, you'll help ensure our platform remains best-in-class for mobile growth and monetization.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain UIs, APIs and backend systems that support liftoff accelerate real-time campaign management, bidding, user targeting, and in-app monetization, primarily by developing configuration management and analytics services.
  • Work with large-scale data sources to enable real-time analytics dashboards and reports.
  • Improve our development environment and engineering systems with AI and LLM tooling, championing agentic workflows that raise the whole team’s velocity and quality.
  • Optimize backend systems for high availability and low-latency response under peak global traffic.
  • Contribute to the scalability and observability of the platform through metrics, logging, and alerting best practices.
  • Develop high value user interfaces that optimize user flow, for both internal and external consumers securely, with a high bar for safety and correctness.
  • Partner closely with product managers, UX stakeholders, operations and bidding / ML engineers to deliver cohesive end-to-end features.
  • Participate in architectural design documentation, discussions and long-term technical planning for infrastructure, systems and platform evolution.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging tools and technologies in the mobile ad tech landscape and bring forward recommendations.
  • Actively participate in code reviews and mentorship opportunities to strengthen team-wide engineering excellence.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.
  • Experience building full stack UI systems.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or Typescript/Node.js.
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with leading edge UI technologies, including React.
  • You operate with Agency and Urgency by taking initiative to solve problems and drive outcomes independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • You have a Growth Mindset and are adaptable, quick to test, iterate, and improve both ideas and your own skill set.
  • Experience in the mobile advertising or app monetization space is a plus.
  • Exposure to mobile SDKs, ad exchanges, or real-time bidding protocols is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, stream processing, and large-scale analytics is a plus.
  • Passion for building performant, scalable systems that operate at a global scale.

Location:
This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:
Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, NYC, Los Angeles/Orange County: $210k - $260k
  • Seattle/Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $193k - $239k
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $180k - $223k

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

title: Software Engineer (starter)
description:
Net afgestudeerd en al echte software gebouwd? Start bij een AI-startup vlak voor de lancering

Heb je tijdens je studie niet alleen opdrachten gemaakt, maar ook echt software gebouwd die mensen gebruiken? Als bijbaan, eigen project of startup? Dan zoeken we jou.

Squid Support is een AI-startup uit Nieuwegein. Onze AI-agent beantwoordt klantvragen voor webshops en handelt nu al duizenden berichten per dag af voor onze eerste klant, een snelgroeiende e-commerce-organisatie met meerdere webshops. We staan vlak voor de publieke lancering.

Waarom dit een goede eerste baan is

  • Je leert meer in een jaar bij ons dan in drie jaar bij een groot bedrijf

  • Je werkt elke dag direct met de oprichters

  • Wat je bouwt staat de volgende dag live, bij echte klanten

  • Je groeit mee met het bedrijf, en je rol groeit mee

Wat we zoeken

  • Een afgeronde of bijna afgeronde wo- of hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur informatica, AI of iets vergelijkbaars

  • Minimaal 1,5 jaar programmeerervaring met TypeScript en/of Python, bijbaan en eigen projecten tellen mee

  • Je bouwt dagelijks met Claude Code, Codex, Cursor of vergelijkbaar

  • Je hebt iets gebouwd dat echt gebruikt wordt, en daar wil je graag over vertellen

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands

Hoe we werken

We werken AI-native: Claude Code, Codex en agentic workflows zijn bij ons de standaard. Er zit geen product owner of projectmanager tussen jou en de klant. Je werkt elke dag direct met de oprichters.

Stack: TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Docker. AI via onder andere OpenAI Agents SDK, LiteLLM en Vertex AI.

Wat je krijgt

  • Een plek in een klein, ambitieus team, net voor de lancering

  • Elke dag samenwerken met de oprichters, en veel leren

  • Echte ownership: wat jij bouwt, gebruiken klanten de volgende dag

  • Meegroeien met het bedrijf: als wij schalen, groeit jouw rol mee

  • €4.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, MacBook Pro en vrije keuze in AI-tooling

  • Hybride: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Nieuwegein

Stuur bij je sollicitatie een link mee naar iets wat je hebt gebouwd en wat echt gebruikt wordt.

title: Mid-level Software Engineer | Professional Services Engineering
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Software Engineer to our Professional Services Engineering team in Brazil!

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Within our Revenue organization, Professional Services Engineering builds and maintains the custom integrations that connect Wellhub to enterprise clients' own HR, payroll, and benefits systems (eligibility feeds, payroll deductions, leavers, custom reports, and remittance files), through an internal Node.js/TypeScript ETL platform. You'll join a small team supporting major global accounts, including Fortune 500 enterprises, leading global financial institutions, and large-scale retail conglomerates. This role is centered on two things: keeping existing client integrations healthy in production, and building and launching new ones as we bring on new clients.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead backend development within an international team, building and maintaining robust, high-traffic APIs and custom system integrations to ensure successful project implementations.
  • Establish and promote best practices in backend development, database management, and technical documentation across deliverables.
  • Partner with Product Managers in internal and external meetings to discuss complex scenarios, map technical demands, and perform end-to-end validations.
  • Own data manipulation and transformation workflows tailored to enterprise client requirements, ensuring accuracy and reliability in production.
  • Drive the creation of detailed reports and operational insights for stakeholders while monitoring business metrics and KPIs.
  • Ensure rigorous tracking of tasks and proactively identify and implement technical process improvements to scale team efficiency.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.


WHO YOU ARE

  • A seasoned software engineer with solid, in-depth knowledge of backend development, TypeScript, and Node.js, backed by a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
  • An engineer with extensive experience in SQL technologies (such as PostgreSQL and MySQL), possessing a deep understanding of common use cases and performance optimization.
  • A technical specialist with proven expertise in creating and maintaining high-traffic APIs capable of handling thousands of requests per second.
  • A cloud-savvy professional with solid familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools, specifically Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A data-driven problem solver skilled in system monitoring, observability, and KPI tracking using tools like Datadog and Grafana.
  • A sharp analytical thinker with strong critical-thinking abilities, advanced/fluent English proficiency for international collaboration, and a preference for advanced Excel skills.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in backend software engineering with Node.js/TypeScript and SQL databases are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
description:
About us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale.

Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks

  • Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure

  • Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features

  • Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines

  • Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs

  • Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment

  • Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load

  • Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet

  • Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)

  • Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms
