title: Coordinator, Legal Support (Part-Time)
description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Legal Support, accountable for providing reliable administrative and general legal support to the Legal team. The position assists with change orders/amendments, work orders/statements of work, document preparation, research, record management, and general legal administration.

The role requires a foundational understanding of commercial law, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work accurately and autonomously in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation, processing, tracking, and administration of change orders/amendments and work orders/statements of work. Support the drafting, formatting, review, and organization of routine commercial documents using approved templates and guidance.
  • Maintain accurate and organized legal files, records, trackers, and supporting documentation. Coordinate follow-up items and assist with general administrative tasks and ad hoc projects during both busy and quieter periods.
  • Assist with routine research and compliance activities, including gathering information, maintaining records, preparing first drafts, and escalating questions or risks to the appropriate Legal team member.
  • Manage assigned tasks across the agreed three-day schedule, communicate progress and potential delays, and work collaboratively with internal stakeholders. Use Microsoft 365 tools to prepare documents, track work, and communicate with the team.
  • Undertake other duties as reasonably required to support the Legal team and broader business needs

Requirements

  • Coursework or studies focused on commercial law.
  • Exposure to intellectual property or privacy law.
  • Current enrolment in a Bachelor of Laws, Juris Doctor, or equivalent legal qualification; or relevant paralegal/legal studies qualification.
  • Previous employment, internship, volunteer, or administrative experience in a professional environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Previous experience in a legal team, law firm, corporate environment, or paralegal role (Desired, but not required).
  • Experience supporting commercial contracts, change orders/amendments, or work orders/statements of work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to prepare, format, organize, and maintain accurate documents and trackers.
  • Familiarity with document management systems (Sharepoint), electronic signature tools (Docusign), and contract management platforms (Jira).

Skills, Knowledge and Specialist Expertise

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote environment while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Reliability, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.
  • Working arrangements: This is a casual position, with hours generally expected to be approximately 9 hours per week. Hours may vary depending on business requirements and Legal team priorities, but expectation is working hours are to be spread across three business days.
  • Interest in commercial law, intellectual property, and data privacy.

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the
    position.
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a variety of learning and development opportunities from internal and external sources focused on leadership, and professional & personal development.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Legal Engineering Counsel
description:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

What weâre looking for

Stedi is hiring a Legal Engineering Counsel to build how our legal work gets done, and to own a large share of it. Every new customer, payer connection, and partnership runs through a contract, and the volume grows every month. Youâll design the systems that handle it (playbooks, review workflows, automation, and AI tooling) and run them on live deals with counterparties ranging from fast-moving healthtech startups to national payers.

This role pairs legal practice with technical skill. You bring strong legal training and a feel for how commercial deals work, and youâve used AI and other technology to make legal work faster and more consistent. What you learn on live deals shapes the systems, and better systems make the next deal faster.

Youâll join a small, effective Legal team with a broad mandate. We keep up with a fast-growing, highly regulated business by investing in good systems and tools, and this role sits at the center of that investment. Healthcare experience is not required â we value strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new industry quickly. If you have the talent and drive to help build a world-class legal function alongside Stediâs experienced legal counsel mentors at a rapidly scaling tech company, we want to talk.

What youâll do

  • Build and own the systems behind Stediâs contracting, including playbooks, clause libraries, templates, intake and approval workflows, and AI-assisted first-pass review.

  • Break recurring legal work into repeatable steps with clear inputs, decision points, and escalation paths, then decide what to automate, what to standardize, and what needs a lawyer.

  • Turn our legal counselâs nuanced advice, negotiation positions, and fallbacks into structured guidance that people and AI tools can apply consistently.

  • Test and measure what you build. Check outputs against real deals, track where the tools fall short, and iterate until they hold up.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts yourself using those systems â including customer agreements, BAAs, NDAs, payer trading partner agreements â from first redline through signature.

  • Structure our contract data so the team (and our tools) can answer questions about our agreements in minutes.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management. Build self-serve paths for routine agreements and field the questions that still need a person.

  • Take on new areas based on interest and business need as Stedi and the Legal team grow.

Who you are

  • Youâre bar-admitted and want to practice law while building the systems that support it.

  • BigLaw or in-house experience, ideally on transactional work, is a strong plus.

  • Youâve built with technology, whether thatâs AI workflows, prompts and evaluations, automations, scripts, or no-code tools, and you can show what you made.

  • Youâre comfortable working with structured data and technical tools, and you pick up new ones quickly. Coding experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • You can explain complex issues in plain language, write clearly, and communicate confidently with executives, lawyers, procurement staff, engineers, and everyone in between.

  • Youâre comfortable with high-volume work, ambiguity, and shifting priorities, and you maintain high quality through effective habits.

  • You move fast, operate with precision, and follow through until the job is done. You thrive in an environment where clarity, accountability, and urgency matter. Youâre hungry to learn, seek out feedback, and put it to work.

Weâve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note:

  • All official communication about roles at Stedi will only come from an @stedi.com email address, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.

title: Freelance Question Reviewers
description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

In addition, you will support a variety of operational and executional tasks, including marketplace listing updates and other day-to-day projects. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and detail-oriented student to gain hands-on e-commerce experience in a fast-growing international environment, with flexible working hours that fit around your studies.

  • Reliable, accountable, and self-motivated, with the initiative to take ownership of tasks and drive them to completion.
  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

title: Ingénieur ou post-doctorant pour l'analyse des données acquises par un radar HF océanographique couvrant le Raz Blanchard
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest.

 

Projet FLOWATT

Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie.

Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin.

Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes.

L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. Une première étape consistera à comprendre les limites des méthodes actuelles, qui ne permettent plus de restituer un état de mer cohérent avec les références disponibles lorsque la vitesse du courant dépasse 1 m/s, comme montré par Lopez et al. (2018). Les méthodes développées seront ensuite évaluées à partir des mesures in situ et des modélisations numériques. Le radar HF constitue ainsi un élément central de ce travail, dont l’amélioration doit permettre de mieux caractériser les états de mer dans les forts courants du Raz Blanchard.

Missions / Activités principales :

Le (la) titulaire du poste sera affecté à l’équipe M3 de l’UMR Lab-STICC et sera en charge des missions principales suivantes :

  • Réaliser une étude bibliographique sur les modèles permettant de décrire l’effet des vagues sur le spectre Doppler mesuré par un radar HF

  • Implémenter un code de simulation intégrant l’effet des vagues à partir d’une description de l’état de mer dans le spectre Doppler

  • Analyser les simulations en les comparant aux mesures réelles pour comprendre l’influence du courant et plus particulièrement des forts courants sur la mesure d’états de mer

  • Proposer et implémenter des évolutions des algorithmes permettant de s’adapter aux forts courants présents sur la zone du Raz Blanchard

Missions / Activité annexe :

 

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole 

Niveau de diplôme et formations

Les candidats doivent être titulaires d’un doctorat et/ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur avec expérience dans un domaine pertinent (océanographie physique côtière, traitement du signal, etc…)

 

Emploi

Postes ouverts aux candidats :

  • Agent contractuel

 

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : 18 mois

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : 1er janvier 2027

Rémunération :

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest, 2 rue François Verny, 29200 BREST

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

Modalités de candidature

  • Un CV détaillé

  • Une lettre de motivation décrivant votre profil et expliquant votre motivation et votre aptitude à occuper ce poste

  • Une ou plusieurs lettres de recommandation

 

Envoyer les documents à guillaume SICOT (

Présentation de l’Ecole

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Connaissances : 

  • Expérience dans la mesure de grandeurs océanographiques :

    - Connaissance en traitement du signal et/ou océanographique physique côtière

  • Expérience en développement informatique :

    - Principalement en Python, des connaissances en C ou Fortran serait un plus

    - Connaissance de Git

Savoir-faire: 

  •   Rédaction de rapports scientifiques et techniques en anglais

  • Préparation et présentation d’exposés scientifiques en anglais

 

Aptitudes: 

  • Autonomie

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe

  • Approche proactive

title: Founding Product Engineer - Listen Labs
description:
Listen Labs

Everyone hates surveys. They’re tedious to fill out and give shallow data. That’s because they’re only a proxy for the real thing: conversations. Through a conversation, you can ask follow-up questions and get deep insights in a way that’s fun for the interviewee. Except you can’t have 1:1 conversations with everyone…

Listen Labs has built an AI interviewer that can ask follow-up questions, like a conversation, but at the scale and ease of use of a survey.

Technical Challenges

Turn qualitative data into quantitative insights

Listen Labs clusters free-form conversation into a structured format. This is not a trivial task. We use embeddings, fine-tuned large language models, and more to solve these problems.

Ask the right questions

Having a great conversation is not trivial. We’re fine-tuning and prompting in novel ways to get the right output from LLMs.

Multi-modality

We’ve built the fastest speech-to-speech pipeline but there’s a number of challenges we need to address to make it better. Our interviewer has audio input and output to the LLM and that’s tricky to get right.

Investors

There’s been $30B+ of market cap created from bringing surveys online. Our partner at Sequoia, [Bryan Schreier](https://www.sequoiacap.com/people/bryan-schreier/), was the first investor in Qualtrics – the $12B survey company.

About you

  • You love working on products end-to-end without detailed direction

  • You want to work in Next.js, TypeScript, and large language models

  • You are a collaborative builder and like to build systems with other engineers in mind.

  • You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.

  • You know when to seek assistance, and it's typically to discuss tradeoffs.

  • You don't scoff at unglamorous engineering tasks, yaks don't shave themselves.

  • Highly technical

  • Interested in building products end-to-end and owning the user experience

  • Excited about large language models

What we offer

  • $150,000 - $200,000 USD in cash.

  • High equity grant even for an early stage startup.

  • Work in person in our office @ 425 2nd St in San Francisco.

title: Embedded Software Leader
description:
Who We Are

Inspiren offers a complete and connected technology ecosystem for senior living. Founded by Michael Wang, a former Green Beret and cardiothoracic nurse, Inspiren was built on the belief that compassionate care and technology can and should coexist.

Our integrated solutions fit into existing workflows and give senior-living operators greater visibility into what is happening across their communities. Supported by nurse specialists and powerful analytics, Inspiren helps teams make informed clinical and operational decisions that improve efficiency, outcomes, and quality of care.

You’ll join a growing global team united by a shared mission, with a new NYC office designed to strengthen collaboration and in-person connection.

About the Role

We are seeking an Embedded Software Leader that will own everything from the OS up on every device we ship: the application software, the update and rollback path, and how tens of thousands of devices behave in senior living communities. When a device goes down in a community, it's a resident safety issue, and your team owns the outcome. Hardware & Firmware own everything below the OS, and you'll work closely with them and our JDM partner. We're open to different levels of leadership experience and will calibrate the scope and level of the role based on the strengths and experience of the person we hire.

What You'll Do

  • Fleet reliability and operations: Define the SLOs (uptime, time-to-recover, OTA success, cloud-dark rate, crash-loop rate), build the telemetry to measure them, and run the operating rhythm: on-call, incident response, postmortems.

  • OTA and release engineering: Own updates, staged rollouts, health checks, and rollback across multiple hardware generations, silicon vendors, and both MCU and Linux devices.

  • Device application platform: Own the embedded Linux application layer (services, containers, configuration, connectivity, on-device inference runtime) and the application logic on MCU devices (LoRaWAN/BLE, pendant and beacon behavior). Keep it decoupled from hardware revisions so your team ships without waiting on firmware or board cycles.

  • Partnership with Hardware, Firmware, and the JDM: Make sure JDM-delivered firmware is something we can build on, and embed your engineers in NPI from bring-up so the people who sustain a device are there when it comes alive.

  • Team building: Own org design, hiring, and career growth for the embedded software team, and set the norms (joint definition of done, shared on-call across the hardware/software seam, clear code ownership) that make cross-team ownership work.

  • AI-native engineering: Bring AI into the codebase: generated test harnesses, fleet log triage, regression analysis, code review augmentation.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in embedded, firmware, edge, or device software, with 2+ years leading a software team

  • Experience hiring, building, and managing teams of embedded or device software engineers

  • You've operated a production fleet: owned OTA, fleet health, and availability for thousands of connected devices in the field. You can walk us through a staged rollout, a rollback you had to execute, and the telemetry that told you to

  • Hands-on depth in embedded Linux applications: you've shipped and sustained the OS-up layer (Yocto or equivalent, systemd, containers on device, connectivity, update clients) on production hardware, and you can engage on what sits below it

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence executive leadership and pivot strategies to meet 1-year and 2-year business goals. Start-up experience is a plus.

Nice To Have

  • Experience working across a hardware/firmware seam (in-house team, ODM/JDM, or both) with a defined interface contract

  • MCU application experience

  • Fleet telemetry and observability at scale

  • Regulated or high-stakes environments (healthcare, safety-critical, HIPAA)

  • On-device ML runtime integration (NVIDIA Jetson, MediaTek NPU, or similar)

  • Experience on the receiving end of an NPI handoff and improving the process

  • At the Director level: you've led multiple teams or managed managers, and owned a multi-quarter hiring plan

What You’ll Get

At Inspiren, you’ll help reshape how older adults live and age with greater safety, connection, and dignity. Here’s how we support the people making that possible:

  • Competitive Compensation — A strong base salary and variable compensation where applicable.

  • Ownership in Our Future — Equity that gives you a stake in the impact and value we’re building together.

  • Growth and Recognition — Semiannual reviews that recognize your contributions and support your continued development.

title: Catastrophe Claims Examiner III
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process insurance claims for property losses based on coverage, appraisal, and verifiable damage. Interact with independent adjusters and policy holders, review claim forms and other records to determine insurance coverage. Make payment recommendations and settlements in accordance with company practices, procedures, and Fair Claims Settlement Practices regulations.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Investigate, evaluate, and resolve claims, applying technical knowledge and human relations skills to promote fair and prompt settlement of claims.
• Adjust reserves and provide reserve recommendations to ensure reserving activities are consistent with company policies.
• Enter claim transactions, in a clear and concise manner.
• Examine claims inspected by independent adjusters, including further investigation of questionable claims, verification of coverage, and timely issuance of payments to policyholders.
• Conduct daily diary reviews on claim files to ensure status letters are sent to policyholders in accordance with Department of Insurance regulations.
• Pay and process claims within designated authority level.
• Supervise independent adjusters to ensure adherence to CFP IA Guidelines.
• Maintain compliance with the Department of Insurance and Company policy and procedures.
• Create correspondence to policyholders that is accurate and complete. Communicate with insureds and/or others involved to secure missing information.
• Promptly negotiate settlements, making sure that the settlement reflects the actual insured losses while ensuring that the insurer is protected from invalid claims.
• Confer with Claims Management and legal counsel on claims involving litigation.
• Requires up to 25% travel, limited to periods of catastrophic events.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This role may include handling the entire claim (except inspection), or may be responsible for a specific coverage, such as Personal Property or Fair Rental Value. This role will focus on claims over $300,000 in damages, but the Claims Examiner III may receive smaller claims when necessary.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Working experience with MS-Office (especially Word and Excel) is required.
• Certified in CEA and Fair Claims Settlement Practices.
• 5 years total claims experience, 2 years handling HO claims over $300,000.

• 2 Years Carrier experience required

Salary: $46.15-$51.28

title: Joinery Estimator
description:
Category: Architectural & Engineering

Location:


Position Title: Joinery Estimator
Work Set-up: Work From Home
Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 7AM-4PM PHT
Salary Budget: 65,000.00 -75,000.00 php

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Estimator with approximately 3–4 years of residential construction estimating experience to join an established Australian residential builder.
Working across custom homes, townhouses and complex residential builds, you will take ownership of estimating and Bills of Quantities (BOQs). This role is suited to someone who values accuracy, enjoys variety and wants to contribute to a close-knit team.

As an Estimator:
You are a practical and analytical construction professional who can interpret plans and specifications, prepare accurate quantity take-offs and manage estimating priorities. You communicate clearly, take accountability for your work and collaborate with the Australian team to clarify project requirements and support efficient project delivery.

Your Responsibilities as an Estimator would be:
A. Estimating & Bills of Quantities
• Prepare accurate and detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for custom residential projects.
• Review architectural plans, drawings, specifications, client selections, and project documents to establish the full scope of works.
• Perform detailed material and construction quantity take-offs using established systems and processes.
• Follow project interview sheets, checklists, and workflows to capture all build requirements and inclusions.
• Estimate custom homes, townhouses, fit-outs, and non-standard residential projects, including steep or complex sites.
B. Systems, Workflow & Documentation
• Maintain accurate project records in iGyro and use Core Estimator or similar software for digital measurements and take-offs.
• Manage estimating tasks from initial project information through to completed BOQs, understanding their impact on procurement and project delivery.
• Maintain organised and timely documentation while following and improving established estimating processes.
C. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
• Work closely with the Australian team to clarify project details and resolve estimating queries.
• Support procurement, construction administration, and related estimating activities as required.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology, workflows, and process improvements.

Qualifications & Skills:
• Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering or a related construction discipline.
• Approximately 3–4 years’ experience in residential construction estimating, ideally working with or supporting Australian builders.
• Strong understanding of Australian residential construction methods, materials and estimating principles.
• Demonstrated ability to interpret architectural plans, drawings, specifications and project documentation accurately.
• Experience preparing detailed quantity take-offs and Bills of Quantities for residential construction projects.
• Strong practical building knowledge and understanding of the residential construction process from start to finish.
• Experience estimating custom homes, complex residential projects and steep or sloping sites is highly desirable.
• Experience using DataBuild, iGyro or comparable Australian construction estimating software is advantageous.
• Experience with Core Estimator or similar digital take-off and measurement software is advantageous.
• Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage estimating priorities and deadlines.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to seek clarification when project information is incomplete or unclear.
• A reliable, accountable and collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively as part of a remote Australian team.
Key Performance Expectations
• Accurate and complete Bills of Quantities and quantity take-offs.
• Timely completion of estimating tasks in line with agreed deadlines and priorities.
• Accurate interpretation of project plans, specifications, selections and scope requirements.
• Consistent use of estimating systems, checklists and established workflows.
• Clear communication and effective resolution of estimating queries with the Australian team.

If this sounds like you, then what are you waiting for? Come join us!
This is an opportunity to join an established Australian residential builder with decades of experience and a reputation for quality workmanship and highly individual projects. You will become part of a close-knit, collaborative team that values professionalism, clear communication and attention to detail, while giving you the trust and opportunity to take genuine ownership of your work.
If you enjoy the variety and challenge of custom construction and want a stable, long-term role where your expertise and contribution are valued, this could be the opportunity for you.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

Our Mission:

Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth.

Our values

  • Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learnerâs potential.

  • Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.

  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. title: Scientist - Functional Genomics
description:
Location: Oxford, London or RTP (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

Role Purpose

A genetic association tells you where in the genome a disease signal lives. It doesn’t tell you why. That’s the question you’ll answer.

As a Scientist in Functional Genomics, you’ll turn genetic associations into biological understanding. You’ll work out which genes and variants are likely to be causal, and through which cell types, tissues and pathways they act. The Life Sciences team then uses that to triage targets and build the evidence behind a development programme. Your work will span the therapeutic development cycle, from target discovery to patient stratification and finding new uses for existing drugs.

This is an early-career role in a highly collaborative team. You’ll have the support to develop and run innovative, rigorous science, and the visibility to share it with internal and external stakeholders.

A Day in the Life

  • Prioritising causal variants and genes at disease-associated loci, bringing together statistical fine-mapping, colocalisation with molecular QTLs (eQTL, pQTL), functional annotation and variant-to-gene evidence

  • Mining our in-house data resources alongside single-cell, bulk expression, epigenomic and proteomic datasets to understand the causal biology of diseases with unmet need

  • Triaging and ranking potential targets, and telling programme teams honestly how strong (and how limited) the genetic evidence is

  • Writing reproducible, well-documented code and methods that feed into the growth of our technology

  • Presenting your findings, in writing and in person, to colleagues and partners at every level of seniority

Who You Are

You’ll bring:

  • A PhD in a quantitative discipline

  • Solid foundations in genetics and molecular biology

  • Solid foundations in statistics (modelling, regression)

  • Statistical programming in Python or R

  • Clear spoken and written communication, the ability to manage your own objectives and deliver on time, and a team-player mindset that puts your work in the bigger picture

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • A broad range of statistical genetics approaches (GWAS, colocalisation, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomisation, polygenic risk scores)

  • Experience with functional genomic data (eQTL/pQTL resources, single-cell or epigenomic data, CRISPR screens)

  • Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high-dimensional statistics and causal inference

  • Software engineering practices (Git and GitHub, testing, documentation, agentic coding, containerisation)

  • Reproducible pipelines (WDL, Snakemake or Nextflow) and cloud or trusted research environments (DNAnexus, Verily Workbench)

  • Methods development within statistical genetics

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Salary: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure competitive compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid Working (e.g., From our London, Oxford Office)

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

If this opportunity excites you, apply now!

We are dedicated to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Genomics politely requests no contact from recruitment agencies. We do not accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies nor accept the fees associated with them.

title: Innovation Internship
description:
About the role

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance.

As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop.

This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes.

  • GHG reduction calculation: Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes

  • Policy Fit: asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation.

  • Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

  • Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies

  • Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions

  • Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast-growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: System Engineer (Control Systems)
description:
System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market
